params.body:
Three fixes in the Studio.

- **Save sits beside the piece.** The editor bar spanned the window with Save at its far edge, a long way from the text on a wide screen. The bar still spans the window, but its contents now sit in the 1180px column of the piece.
- **Yours | Team on the desk.**
  - The single word that flipped between "mine" and "everyone" read as a label, not a switch. It is now a two-part switch with both choices named.
  - The desk opens on **Yours**.
  - Drafts stay private to their author through the pipeline (gentells-pipeline #247), not through this filter. "Team" shows what the team shares: shared drafts, pieces in review and published pieces.
- **Stronger mode icons on the home page:** a solid tile in the mode colour (crimson for Write, aqua for Curate) with a white mark, instead of a faint tint.

Checked with `npm run build` and screenshots of the home page, the desk and the editor against mocked data.
params.title: Studio: Save beside the piece, Yours or Team on the desk, solid mode icons
